themes.label: Good service and respectful staff
themes.definition: Praise for service quality or for staff and loan officers being kind, respectful, helpful or easy to reach. Not speed of the loan process (loan_speed_positive).

themes.label: Fast, easy loan process
themes.definition: The loan is quick or easy to get: fast approval, processing and disbursement. Few documents or no guarantor goes to requirements_positive.

themes.label: Low or fair interest rates
themes.definition: Interest rates described as low, fair or better than other lenders.

themes.label: Positive impact on business, household or family
themes.definition: The loan improved income, business, assets, living standards, children's schooling or helped through an emergency or hard time.

themes.label: Flexible, manageable repayment
themes.definition: Repayment schedules are easy or flexible, or staff are understanding when a client is late or in hardship.

themes.label: Trustworthy and transparent
themes.definition: VisionFund is honest, transparent, reliable or treats clients fairly as an institution. Kindness of individual staff goes to staff_service_positive.

themes.label: Few requirements, easy to qualify
themes.definition: Few documents, no guarantor or collateral, or easy to qualify compared with other lenders.

themes.label: Respectful collection
themes.definition: Says VisionFund does not pressure or harass clients when collecting, including fair handling of late payments.

themes.label: Helps women and vulnerable people
themes.definition: VisionFund helps women, the poor or vulnerable community members, said about others rather than the client's own gains.

themes.label: Training, insurance or savings
themes.definition: Praise for training, advice, insurance cover or savings products.

themes.label: Recommends, with a complaint or ask
themes.definition: Recommends VisionFund but adds a complaint or a wanted change (for example poor communication, slow service, a higher amount). Also code the complaint itself if it has its own code.
